title: Technical Account Manager
description:
MongoDB Technical Account Managers are at the forefront of technical problem solving with key customers, working on some of the most complex and exciting application ecosystems built on the MongoDB platform. TAMs combine: Deep product knowledge and expertise across multiple domains Polished technical communications Strong account leadership, with the ability to engage effectively at all levels of the customer Ability to not only proactively engage, but anticipate and preempt needs a customer may have or issues they could experience A high degree of ownership and willingness to go above and beyond for our customers The TAMs primary remit is the cultivation of customer confidence and delivery of positive, account-wide technical outcomes that solve big customer problems while showcasing the capabilities of the MongoDB product portfolio. They do this through a systematic engagement process including deep discovery and the development of a roadmap of shared objectives. They are able to operate in complex environments where there may be shared or even ambiguous responsibilities between the customer and MongoDB. The TAM is able to shift gears between enabling, coaching and mentoring, and marshaling resources to get the right things done at the right time. The TAM also acts as the eyes and ears of the product team while working with marquee customers as they will sometimes surface new requirements or potential areas of opportunity for future development. They work closely with these teams to understand these requirements, manage expectations, and ensure MongoDB is staying one step ahead of customer needs. This role will be an early hire into the new Technical Account Management function and will help pioneer the new service offering for MongoDB. Successful candidates will have the flexibility to work around the schedules of customers with 100% uptime systems while enjoying the life/work balance MongoDB promotes. We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. Cool things you'll do 
 MongoDB is on a mission to unlock the inner genius of our customers by making data stunningly easy to work with. Along the way, our customers encounter questions and issues about how our approach to databases works for their use case. In Technical Services, it's our job to help our customers succeed with MongoDB As a Technical Account Manager, you'll be highly engaged with a handful of our largest customers, building key relationships with technical leaders and collaborating with them on their projects to build and scale MongoDB solutions - resolving questions and demonstrating solutions related to architecture, performance, recovery, security, and everything in between You'll be an expert resource on the best way to run MongoDB at scale, whatever that scale may be. You will identify deep dive opportunities to educate our customers on crucial topics of concern to them and either conduct those deep dives yourself or make timely connections between customers and subject matter experts within MongoDB You will also mentor and ramp new team members, and take initiatives in building knowledge of new product lines within the MongoDB ecosystem What you need 
 You should have 7+ years of relevant experience. We consider all candidates, with an eye for those who combine formal education with self-teaching, are insatiably curious, and are multi-faceted It's crucial for every candidate to check these boxes: Communicator: Foster open lines of communication amongst internal stakeholders; The TAM ensures all concerned parties, including in some cases the MongoDB executive team, are well informed about accounts within the TAMs portfolio (especially during critical or escalated situations) Great communication and account leadership skills of external stakeholders, with a good organizational understanding of customers and ability to calibrate communication style based on the audience The TAM must quickly understand and communicate about customer workloads, use cases, and resiliency criteria, including performance, availability, and scalability Collaborator: Ability to work independently as well as cross-functionally to ensure customer needs are being met Genuine desire to help people, and to increase their confidence and good will Ability to cultivate strong team partnerships: Understanding of when and how to seek help from team members, skill in choosing from potentially conflicting perspectives or approaches; ability to secure commitments and lead collaborative efforts Problem Solver: Comfort thinking on your feet, solving problems in real-time, and reducing pressure and anxiety through calm, authoritative technical leadership; ability to keep your cool and project command presence during escalated situations where tensions and anxiety may be high Ability to design, communicate, and follow a structured approach to solving complex problems based loosely upon the scientific method Experience analyzing and pursuing issues holistically in the enterprise; spanning multiple technologies, customer teams and silos Technical Expert: Experience building, maintaining, tuning, and troubleshooting sophisticated mission-critical production database systems Familiarity with modern service architectures and the implications on development teams, their structures and the development lifecycle Experience with the technologies and development patterns typical of a large-scale enterprise customer Experience using any cloud services stack such as AWS, Azure or GCP Builder: Develop, document, and help implement techniques, tools and procedures for optimizing MongoDBs technical relationship with marquee customers Product evangelism: The TAM helps customers understand how the MongoDB developer data platform is well-suited to solve a wide variety of their problems 

 Bonus Points 
 Experience managing large scale databases (e.g. RDBMS, NoSQL) Extensive experience with mass scale application architectures Microservices/Serverless architectures CI/CD tools and approaches Containerization, orchestration and management tools Enterprise Identity platforms Experience using or managing MongoDB Experience using distributed version control systems, and in particular git Strong systems engineering and troubleshooting experience, including Linux performance, memory management, I/O tuning, configuration, security, networking, virtualization, clustering 

 Success Measures 
 In 3 months, you will have gained a deep understanding of MongoDB and its ecosystem. You will complete New Hire Training In 6 months, you will be confident working frontline with our customers. You will also complete the MongoDB Certified DBA Associate exam In 12 months, you will be directly and independently engaged in technical account management, ensuring customers are successful and happy with MongoDB and see our developer data platform as the de facto standard for new projects

title: Junior Devops Engineer
description:
Job Title: Junior DevOps Engineer (GCP & Kubernetes) Experience: 13 Years
Type: Full-time 
 Role Overview - We are looking for a Junior DevOps Engineer to join our technology team and help us build, maintain and improve our cloud infrastructure and deployment processes. You will work closely with our Engineering and Product teams to support our GCP-based infrastructure, Kubernetes/GKE environments, CI/CD pipelines and cloud operations. The role will provide exposure to infrastructure automation, monitoring, security and reliability, with a strong focus on learning and building scalable DevOps practices. The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in cloud and DevOps concepts, is comfortable working with Linux, Docker, Kubernetes and Terraform, and is eager to learn and take ownership of infrastructure and deployment-related problems. 
 Key Responsibilities - 
 Cloud Infrastructure & Operations Support the management and day-to-day operations of our GCP infrastructure, including VPCs, IAM, compute and networking. Assist in maintaining secure and reliable cloud environments across development, staging and production. Support configuration of firewall rules, networking policies and access controls. Monitor infrastructure health, resource utilisation and availability, and proactively identify issues. Assist with troubleshooting infrastructure and application deployment issues. 
 Kubernetes & Containers Support the deployment and management of applications on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE). Work with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm and Kustomize to manage containerised applications. Assist in configuring Kubernetes deployments, services, ingress, configurations and secrets. Support implementation of Kubernetes best practices around access control, resource management and networking. Troubleshoot pod, deployment, networking and container-related issues. 
 CI/CD & DevOps Automation Maintain and improve GitHub Actions and Google Cloud Build pipelines. Automate build, test and deployment workflows to improve engineering efficiency. Assist in implementing automated checks and security scans as part of CI/CD pipelines. Support deployment processes across development, staging and production environments. Help troubleshoot failed builds and deployments and document recurring issues. 
 Infrastructure as Code Work with Terraform to provision and manage cloud infrastructure. Maintain and update existing Terraform configurations and modules. Follow infrastructure-as-code best practices and ensure changes are properly reviewed and documented. Assist in identifying and resolving infrastructure configuration issues. 
 Security & Reliability Follow security best practices across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes and CI/CD environments. Assist with IAM, secrets management, encryption and access controls. Support vulnerability scanning and remediation across container images and infrastructure. Assist with maintaining secure configuration of applications and cloud resources. Participate in incident troubleshooting and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for infrastructure and deployment issues. 
 Monitoring & Incident Management Monitor infrastructure and application performance using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana and GCP Cloud Logging. Support alert management and investigation of infrastructure issues. Participate in incident response and help ensure timely resolution of production issues. Maintain runbooks and documentation for common operational issues and processes. 
 Collaboration & Documentation Work closely with Engineering, Product and other teams to support smooth application deployments and reliable infrastructure. Document infrastructure, deployment processes and operational procedures. Identify repetitive manual processes and opportunities for automation. Continuously learn and adopt better tools and practices to improve reliability, security and developer experience. 
 Required Skills & Qualifications 13 years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, SRE or a similar role. Good understanding of Linux systems, networking and cloud infrastructure. Hands-on experience with GCP or another major cloud platform, with willingness to deepen GCP expertise. Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes; exposure to GKE is preferred. Familiarity with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code concepts. Experience with Git and GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD tools. Basic understanding of IAM, networking, secrets management and cloud security. Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana or GCP Cloud Logging. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Ability to work effectively with engineering teams in a fast-paced environment. 
 Preferred Skills Hands-on experience with GCP GKE. Exposure to Helm, Kustomize and ArgoCD/GitOps. Experience with PostgreSQL and RabbitMQ from an infrastructure or operations perspective. Familiarity with Google Secret Manager or HashiCorp Vault. Exposure to security scanning tools such as Trivy, tfsec or Checkov. Basic understanding of Kubernetes security, RBAC and Network Policies. Exposure to Prometheus, Grafana, Elasticsearch or ELK. Experience working in a fintech or regulated environment is a plus. Relevant cloud or Kubernetes certifications are a plus. 
 Our Tech Stack Cloud: GCP (VPC, IAM, Cloud Armor, Secret Manager) Orchestration: GKE, Helm, Kustomize, Docker IaC: Terraform CI/CD: GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Cloud Build Messaging/Data: RabbitMQ, PostgreSQL Monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana, Elasticsearch, Cloud Logging
